summary: K-Tech Solutions (NASDAQ: KMRK) filed a Form 6-K announcing an October 14, 2026 Sale and Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Flourish Ventures Trading Pte Ltd, a Singapore-based wholesale trader, from its controlling shareholders Messrs. Kwok Yiu Keung, Kwok Yiu Wah and Kwok Yiu Fai. Consideration is 43,800,000 Class A ordinary shares issued as stock. The Audit Committee approved the related-party transaction; no advisor or per-share value was disclosed. Completion is subject to customary conditions, expected on or before October 31, 2026. Watch dilution, related-party governance and Nasdaq share-issuance approvals.
